items: Bar widgets: Caps Lock / Num Lock, network speed, disk usage, graphics card, VPN, the line of the song being sung (lyrics), spacers, and custom widgets from your own commands
What scrolling, middle-click and right-click on the empty bar do; hide the bar during the overview; an auto-hidden bar shows for a moment when switching workspaces
A right-click menu on the desktop, and a Dynamic island at the top for media, notifications and volume
Session menu: a countdown, hibernate, restart into the firmware setup, switch user, number keys
Hooks: your own commands when the wallpaper, dark mode or colors change, on lock, unlock and startup
A browser picker for links, Wi-Fi as a QR code (and a QR code maker), terminal sessions (tmux, zellij) in the launcher, and this What's new
Region & Language: the system language and formats, adding languages, the date style and the first day of the week
Wallpaper: a plain color, center and tile, favorites, one for light and one for dark mode, a folder per screen
A preferred media player and players to ignore; Bluetooth signal strength and reconnecting your devices
Dock: a dot per window, tinted icons, only this screen's apps; warning and critical levels for the system monitor; a lowest brightness
Plugin update notices and a lock file; palettes from the DMS theme registry in Get themes
The launcher finds open windows, settings, session actions and files (/), searches the web, pins apps and has a grid view
Notification rules per app, and a window rules editor
Flamenco's own password dialog (polkit)
Toasts when Caps Lock, the keyboard layout, the power profile, Wi-Fi or Do Not Disturb change
Low and critical battery warnings, and separate idle times on battery
Bluetooth scanning and pairing, Settings → Bluetooth, and a tidier Settings order
Resizing floating windows (their own frames, and a Resize… panel); the microphone indicator only while in use, in five looks
Pop-ups when drives and accessories are plugged in or taken out
The bar in a corner, its length and alignment, icon size; the Unity layout
Text color, text cursor color and a recolored mouse pointer
Get themes: icons, cursors, GTK themes, color schemes, wallpapers and fonts from one place
